data_description.max_reasonable_hourly_cons: Hourly usage above this many gallons is recorded as zero. Use 0 to disable this guard.
data_description.skip_negative_corrections: Record negative hourly values as zero. Disable to retain signed utility corrections in statistics.
data_description.time_raw_mode: Interpret utility timestamps without an offset as UTC or as your Home Assistant local timezone. Explicit offsets are preserved. Changing this creates a separate statistics series.
